description: Get the full record for one Kingdom Hearts catalog item. Pass a sku_id from discover/resolve_listing (e.g. {sku_id: "ichiban-kuji-kh-2018-a"}), or a free-text query such as {query: "Sora Bring Arts Halloween Town"} to get the best match. Returns names (en/ja), product line (maker, line type, release date), characters, original price (msrp_jpy, price_local, currency, price_basis), acquisition_type (retail, kuji, prize, …), availability (hint + confidence), typical_channels, shipping (whether it is only sold at shops that ship within Japan, so a shipping-forwarding service is needed from abroad; costs are not calculated), size/weight, re-release dates, official (licensed or fan-made), verified (checked against the source) and source_url.

query.description: Free-text product name in English or Japanese when you have no sku_id, e.g. "一番くじ キングダムハーツ A賞".

sku_id.description: Catalog SKU ID, e.g. "ichiban-kuji-kh-2018-a". Either sku_id or query is required.

name: explain_product
